title: Account sign-in (Internet Identity)
constraints: Do not add new authentication providers; Internet Identity must remain the only supported sign-in method.

Do not edit files in frontend immutablePaths (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
Keep all Motoko backend logic in the single actor (backend/main.mo). Only add backend/migration.mo if state schema changes require migration.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding username/password accounts or email/password sign-in.
Integrating third-party OAuth providers (Google, GitHub, Facebook, Auth0).
Adding multi-factor authentication settings screens beyond what Internet Identity provides.
